convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iStochastic indicators with standard parameters. Simple entry rules (price pattern + stochastic confirmation). Fixed lot sizing. No external custom indicators or .mqh libraries affecting trading logic. Standard MQL5 Trade library includes only.

derived_values.name: Adjusted point value for 3/5 digit brokers

other_exits: No short signal to close longs; no explicit close logic - positions are managed only by SL/TP

custom_logic_notes: BUY-ONLY EA - no short/sell entry logic exists. Entry requires 4 consecutive bars with strictly ascending highs AND strictly ascending opens (bars [1],[2],[3],[4] relative to current bar [0]). Both Stochastic indicators on different timeframes (M5 and M6) must have main line above signal line on both current bar [0] and previous bar [1]. Stochastic parameters are hardcoded (K=5, D=3, slowing=3, SMA, Low/High) - not configurable via inputs. The two timeframe periods must satisfy sto_period_1 < sto_period_2 (validated in OnInit). Position count is checked against InpMaxPositions before entry - this acts as a cap on total same-direction positions (buy only). Margin check is performed via CTrade.CheckVolume() before order send.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward conversion. Multi-timeframe stochastic requires care - two Stochastic instances on M5 and M6 timeframes. The 4-bar ascending pattern check uses bars [1],[2],[3],[4] relative to the new bar. SL/TP need digit adjustment (multiply by 10 for 5-digit brokers). Only buy-side logic exists - no short entries. Position counting filters by magic number and symbol. The new-bar guard uses datetime comparison. CTrade/CSymbolInfo are standard MQL5 library wrappers - map to direct broker API calls in Python.
